g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: Legend — solid: owns · dark: relationship · dashed: reference

a.xlink:title: Define member lifecycle and reminder creation contracts.
Own the lifecycle and ordinary visibility of members.
Create reminders for members who remain available in ordinary flows.
Create a reminder for a member who is available in ordinary flows.
An archived member is invisible and inassignable in ordinary flows.
Creating a valid reminder makes it available to its assigned member.
A reminder can be assigned only to a member available in ordinary flows.
Represent a member whose lifecycle determines ordinary visibility and assignability.
Represent a reminder that is created for a designated member.
